structured_output.outcome: Triaged → Inbox, blocked on requester. No learner outcome is stated; this is an internal board-reporting need. It cannot be drafted or sized until marketing says (a) what the funnel stages are and which system holds each, (b) what "learner engagement" is as a single number, and (c) whether this is a one-off export for the deck or a recurring dashboard. Enrolment-funnel data is not in any system the platform context names; engagement data lives in Canvas, and whether it is readable from myNXU is an open unknown. Hidden dependencies: Canvas (engagement — blocking, unsizeable without it), the unnamed admissions/CRM source for the funnel (blocking), and finance's market list (non-blocking). Fastest route to Monday is a hand-pulled export, which is a different piece of work from a dashboard and should be asked for as such.

urgency.claim: Needed by Monday 9am because the board meets then; "nothing fancy, just the numbers."
urgency.evidence: The board date is concrete and external. Nothing in the request shows the numbers must come from a built dashboard — a spreadsheet or exported table serves a slide equally. No evidence given that the data is currently unobtainable by hand.
urgency.assessment: The deadline is real for the numbers, not for a product feature. A dashboard cannot be built, verified and trusted for a board between Friday and Monday 9am; a one-off pull might be, if the source systems are accessible today. Treat as: urgent one-off data request (separate, small, owner to confirm feasibility today) + non-urgent dashboard request that goes to Thursday triage.

duplicate.why: No open issues were shortlisted; nothing on the board covers board-level reporting, enrolment funnel or engagement metrics.

size.risk: Data access. If funnel data sits in a marketing/admissions tool the team does not integrate with, or engagement is not readable from Canvas via myNXU, this becomes XL/unsizeable. If both sources are already queryable and the ask is a one-off export, it is S.

questions.text: Is this a one-off set of numbers for Monday's deck, or a dashboard the board sees every meeting? These are different pieces of work; answer for both if both are wanted.

Name the funnel stages you want counted (e.g. lead → applied → ID-verified → invoice paid → started) and, for each stage, the system that is the source of record. The platform context names no admissions/CRM system; the team does not hold this data unless you say where it is.
Define "learner engagement" as one measurable thing: logins per week, module completion, assignment submission rate, or something else. Which one, over what period?
Which markets, and is "market" the finance-maintained list used for referral eligibility, or a marketing segmentation?
Can the team read engagement signals from Canvas today (submissions, module items, activity) via myNXU, the Canvas API or Canvas reports — and at what grain?

Do any of the funnel stages already exist as events or records myNXU holds (document status changed, invoice issued/paid, registration window, course start), so part of the funnel can be built without a new integration?
If this becomes recurring: where does it live — an internal admin view in myNXU, or an external BI tool the board is handed — and who is the audience beyond the board?

structured_output.requester_message:
You asked for an enrolment-funnel-by-market and learner-engagement dashboard for Monday's 9am board meeting.

Two things are tangled here, and I need you to separate them today.

1. The numbers for Monday. A dashboard cannot be built and trusted by Monday morning. What might be possible is a hand-pulled export, if the data is somewhere the team can reach. To find that out, I need from you by end of today (Friday): the funnel stages you want counted and which system holds each stage; what "learner engagement" means as one number; and which markets. Without those, nobody can start, because the platform holds engagement data in Canvas and the enrolment funnel is not in any system the team owns. Once you send them, an engineer can tell you today whether the pull is doable over the weekend. I can't promise the numbers will exist.

2. The dashboard. That goes to Thursday triage as a product request. Bring the same answers plus: is this every board meeting, and who else sees it.

What this costs: the team is mid-sprint. Whoever does the weekend pull puts down their current sprint item for however long it takes, and that item slips. If the pull turns into an integration with a marketing system or Canvas, it does not fit before Thursday at all.

Send the four answers today and the pull gets assessed today. Send them by Thursday and the dashboard gets triaged then.
